# Pinned second-place source

Author repository: https://github.com/Yamato-Arai/kaggle-cmi-detect-behavior-2nd-place-solution

Commit: `cb53f8d0cc82f33b86403ba35c5a580930475528`.

The seven original files are copied unchanged from our byte-checked reference.
`configs/second_place_source.json` records SHA256 after CRLF-to-LF normalization.
Original author comments and README are preserved. Do not edit this snapshot to
implement experiments; project changes belong in `second_place_hybrid.py` and
the separate hybrid training/evaluation scripts. Full upstream train/test entry
points are retained as source records and are not imported or executed.

Our fixed-five-fold experiments are adaptations, not the author's original
ten-fold, three-architecture ensemble or leaderboard result.
